about: Every recorded line in the games. The name on the left is the sound file; the words on the right are what the voice says. To change a line: edit the words, delete its sound file, and run tools/make-voice.py again. Only missing files are recorded, so nothing is paid for twice.

audio/replay.mp3: Great job! You did it again!
audio/g1/hello.mp3: Hello! I am Doctor... um... Doctor Somebody! I forgot my name again. My clock balloon floated all the way up to space! I need four star crystals to fly home. Tap a planet to find one.
audio/g1/start.mp3: We need four star crystals to fly home. Tap a planet to find one.
audio/g1/left1.mp3: We need one more star crystal. Tap a planet!
audio/g1/left2.mp3: We need two more star crystals. Tap a planet!
audio/g1/left3.mp3: We need three more star crystals. Tap a planet!
audio/g1/won.mp3: You did it! A space friend has a star crystal for us. Give them a tap!
audio/g1/boarded.mp3: Thank you, friend! One more star crystal for the clock balloon!
audio/g1/finale.mp3: Tick tock! The clock balloon is full of star power! Thank you! Now, where was I going? I forget!
audio/g1/again.mp3: Oh dear. I floated back up to space! Let's find more star crystals.
audio/g2/hello.mp3: Hello! Doctor Somebody here. At least, I think that is my name. The clock balloon has landed in ancient Egypt, thousands of years ago! But a sandstorm blew four golden gears out of my clock. Tap a place to help me find one.

audio/g2/finale.mp3: Tick tock! The clock is fixed! Thank you! Goodbye, Egypt! Now, when was I going next? I forget!
audio/g2/again.mp3: Oh no. Another sandstorm! The gears have blown away again. Let's find them.
